ModMetaData.name: Dead Ship
ModMetaData.author: Zak
ModMetaData.description:
[b]DEAD SHIP (ALPHA)[/b] A horror start for RimWorld inspired by Dead Space. Something in the wreckage is humming, and the Marker is the best power source you will ever have.
[b]ALPHA: expect bugs.[/b] Start a new colony; saves may break between updates.
[b]Necromorphs[/b] [list] [*] [b]Slasher[/b]: the starter. Fragile limbs, a tough torso, and it keeps coming. [*] [b]Pregnant[/b]: bursts into swarmers. [*] [b]Puker[/b]: spits acid from range. [i]From day 10.[/i] [*] [b]Lurker[/b]: tentacle barbs at range, tentacles up close. [i]From day 10.[/i] [*] [b]Pack[/b]: fast and in numbers. [i]From day 10.[/i] [*] [b]Exploder[/b]: slow, and blows itself up on your walls. [i]From day 15.[/i] [*] [b]Leaper[/b]: closes the gap in one jump. [i]From day 15.[/i] [*] [b]Brute[/b]: tears structures down. [i]From day 30.[/i] [/list] Cut off their limbs to stop them. They always know where your colonists are.
[b]Also in the mod[/b] The Marker as a power source with a price, sanity, ventilation, new weapons and armour, and two starts. Details are in the README in the mod folder.
[b]Compatibility[/b] Combat Extended supported. Does not require Anomaly. Works with or without Ideology, Royalty and Biotech.
[i]Fan-made and not affiliated with or endorsed by Electronic Arts. Dead Space is a trademark of its owner.[/i]
